name: Multiresolution Hilbert Curve for Annotations
definition: A technique to reduce display clutter and interaction slowdown when drawing many annotation pipes by using a multiresolution Hilbert curve instead of a single high-resolution curve.
summary: Multiresolution Hilbert Curve for Annotations visualizes genomic data as 3D pipes along a Hilbert curve, using a hierarchy of resolutions to reduce clutter and maintain performance across zoom levels.
